description: Ask the arena for a table and wait for it to be set (a person of near rating, or a Guild duelist after twenty seconds). Returns the table in words with your legal actions numbered when it is your action. One call waits at most 50 seconds; if the table is still being found, call find_table or table_state again.

wait_seconds.description: how long to wait for a table (default 45, at most 50)

name: find_table
